purpose: Teach: 輪廻/撃沈/怒涛/凱旋/建立/警備隊/生まれつき/オウム真理教

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が輪廻を信じていた事を警察、確認されましたね
lines.en: The police have confirmed that the suspect in this case believed in reincarnation, haven't they?
lines.style: Measured, observant tone. Slight upward inflection at the end—genuine curiosity, not leading. Pause between 'case' and the observation, like turning something over in his mind.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不審船を撃沈ではなく停船命令で対応します
lines.en: The police will handle the suspicious vessel with a stop order, not by sinking it.
lines.style: Clear, official delivery. Firm but not harsh. Even cadence. The weight of procedure in every word. Slight emphasis on 'stop order' to mark the decision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、怒涛のように寄せられた情報を警察、整理されてますね
lines.en: The police have been organizing all this information that's been pouring in about the case, it seems.
lines.style: Acknowledging, slightly impressed. Soft admiration underneath—recognizing effort. Gentle rhythm. Small smile in the voice without condescension.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民活動の凱旋的なお祝いをご支援されますね
lines.en: The police are supporting this as a triumph for citizen action, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm, collegial tone. A touch of genuine respect woven in. Relaxed pace, like affirming something good. The slight lift of someone pleased to see the right thing happen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不法建立物の取り壊しを警察、ご対応されてますね
lines.en: The police are handling the demolition of the illegally constructed building in this case, I see.
lines.style: Observant, slightly formal. Measured acknowledgment. Quiet recognition of practical work being done. No rush—letting the importance of the action land naturally.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、警備隊との連携を強化します
lines.en: The police are strengthening their coordination with security units.
lines.style: Direct, professional. Clipped but not curt. The confidence of someone stating necessary action. No softening—just clear intent.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、生まれつきの障害を持つ被害者への配慮を警察、なさってますね
lines.en: The police are showing thoughtfulness toward the victim who was born with disabilities, aren't they?
lines.style: Quiet respect. Gentle emphasis on 'thoughtfulness'—noting care taken. Slow, deliberate pace. The voice of someone recognizing humanity in procedure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、オウム真理教事件の教訓を生かして対応します
lines.en: The police are applying the lessons learned from the Aum case to their response.
lines.style: Grave but not alarmist. Weight in the tone—history being carried forward. Steady, intentional delivery. The gravity of learning from past failure.
